final: WITH j AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, f.feerate, f.rebrate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009), g AS (SELECT orderslink, side, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net, COUNT(feerate - rebrate) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY orderslink, side), s AS (SELECT side, AVG(avg_net) AS side_avg FROM g GROUP BY side) SELECT g.orderslink, g.side, g.avg_net, g.cnt, g.avg_net - s.side_avg AS diff FROM g JOIN s ON g.side = s.side WHERE g.avg_net > s.side_avg ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
